There may be some argument among friends over pop songwriter Ross Golan's 'The Wrong Man'...but if loving the incredible Joshua Henry is wrong, I don't want to be right. Simply put, Henry proves to be the perfect choice to anchor this slick 90-minute sung-through musical.
